# Nularo

> Nularo is an iPhone app: a virtual creature that lives on your Apple Health data. It reads sleep, steps, workouts, resting heart rate and HRV automatically (no logging), reacts every morning with a blunt verdict on how you actually slept and moved, and computes a weekly Creature Age that rises when habits slip. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nularo/id6792171696

## Guides

- [Free accountability buddy apps, and what free really means](https://nularo.com/guides/accountability-buddy-app-free/): Your iPhone does free accountability with shared Reminders and Fitness sharing. Focusmate and Habitica have real free tiers. Supporti and Beeminder mostly do not.
- [How to calculate social jet lag from your own sleep data](https://nularo.com/guides/how-to-calculate-social-jet-lag/): Social jet lag is the gap between your mid-sleep on free days and on workdays. The formula, a worked example, and how to pull the times from Apple Health.
- [Doomscrolling before bed: the iPhone settings that stick](https://nularo.com/guides/doomscrolling-before-bed/): Reddit fixes for doomscrolling in bed wear off because iPhone limits are easy to ignore. The Screen Time, Sleep Focus and grayscale settings that hold.
- [Sleepmaxxing apps: what is worth tracking, and what to skip](https://nularo.com/guides/sleepmaxxing-apps/): Most of a sleepmaxxing app is already free on iPhone and Apple Watch. What the SleepMaxx apps actually do, and when chasing a sleep score backfires.
- [Pengu app alternatives: shared pets for couples and friends](https://nularo.com/guides/pengu-app-alternatives/): Pengu is now Friends, an AI companion app with ads and a Pengu Pass. Widgetable, Pookie, FurTwo, SumOne, Finch and Pikmin Bloom compared for couples.
- [Does Apple Watch resting heart rate include sleep?](https://nularo.com/guides/does-apple-watch-resting-heart-rate-include-sleep/): No. Apple Watch resting heart rate leaves out readings taken while you sleep, so it runs higher than the overnight number Oura, Whoop or Garmin show.
- [Does Apple Watch track HRV during sleep? How to see your night HRV](https://nularo.com/guides/apple-watch-hrv-during-sleep/): Yes, but most watches take only a few HRV readings a night. Series 12 and Ultra 4 sample far more often and show overnight HRV in Vitals.
- [Does Apple Watch have a recovery score? Three things called recovery](https://nularo.com/guides/does-apple-watch-have-recovery-score/): Only Series 12 and Ultra 4 get one: Readiness, a 0-10 score. Every watch since watchOS 9 has Cardio Recovery, which is a heart rate drop, not a score.
- [Apple Sleep Score vs AutoSleep: what each one grades](https://nularo.com/guides/apple-sleep-score-vs-autosleep/): Apple's free Sleep Score grades duration, bedtime and interruptions. AutoSleep's $9.99 Sleep Rating grades you against goals you set. Which to keep.
- [Apple Watch sleep graph explained: stages, gaps and views](https://nularo.com/guides/apple-watch-sleep-graph-explained/): How to read the Apple Watch sleep graph in Health: what Awake, REM, Core and Deep mean, why the night steps up and down, and which parts to trust.
- [Apple Watch time in bed: why it is missing or shorter than sleep](https://nularo.com/guides/apple-watch-time-in-bed/): Apple stopped recording Time in Bed on watchOS 11 and iOS 18. Here is why old nights can show less time in bed than asleep, and what to check instead.
- [Free Bevel alternatives: what you can replace without paying](https://nularo.com/guides/bevel-alternative-free/): Bevel's tracking is still free. Pro ($99.99/yr) adds AI, Biological Age and Health Records, and Apple or cheaper apps cover most of that for free.
- [Fitness age on Apple Watch: where to find it and how to read it](https://nularo.com/guides/apple-watch-fitness-age/): Apple Watch has no fitness age screen, but Cardio Fitness gives you the VO2 max to work one out. Where to find it, how to read it, and why it may run old.
- [How to see Apple Health Age (and why it is not there yet)](https://nularo.com/guides/how-to-see-apple-health-age/): You cannot see Apple's Health Age yet. iOS 27.2 shipped on October 26, 2026 without the new Health app. What it needs, and what to check meanwhile.
- [Free stress apps for Apple Watch: what they actually measure](https://nularo.com/guides/apple-watch-stress-app-free/): Apple Watch has no stress score. Bevel and Athlytic add one free from heart rate and HRV, Welltory gives one reading a day, and Apple offers State of Mind.
- [Sleep consistency apps: what each one actually measures](https://nularo.com/guides/sleep-consistency-apps/): Apple Watch already scores bedtime consistency over 13 nights. How AutoSleep, Athlytic, Bevel, Whoop and Oura define consistency, and why they disagree.
- [Apps that rate your sleep: how each one grades a night](https://nularo.com/guides/apps-that-rate-your-sleep/): Apple Watch already scores every night out of 100. How Apple, AutoSleep, Bevel, Sleep Cycle and SleepScore grade sleep, and why their scores disagree.
- [Sleep apps for night shift workers on iPhone and Apple Watch](https://nularo.com/guides/sleep-app-for-night-shift-workers/): Apple Watch records day sleep if you give it a schedule. Here is how to set one up for nights or rotating shifts, and which apps are built for shift work.
- [Why is my Apple Watch HRV always low? (What the number means)](https://nularo.com/guides/apple-watch-hrv-always-low/): Apple Watch reports HRV as SDNN from spot readings, so it is not on the same scale as Whoop or Oura. Compare it with your own trend, not other people's.
- [Tamagotchi apps for self care: which pets forgive a bad week](https://nularo.com/guides/self-care-tamagotchi-apps/): Finch, Kinder World, Quabble, Urso, Pengu, Palli and Nularo compared by what feeds the pet, what happens when you skip a day, and what it costs.
- [Apps that roast you, sorted by what they roast](https://nularo.com/guides/apps-that-roast-you/): Most roast apps take a selfie and sell a weekly subscription. These roast what you actually did instead: your music, your runs, your weather, your sleep.
- [Gamified sleep tracker apps: rewards vs consequences](https://nularo.com/guides/gamified-sleep-tracker-apps/): Pokémon Sleep, SleepTown and Nularo turn sleep into a game in different ways. What each one measures, what it rewards, and how Apple Watch fits in.
- [Does Apple Watch have a Body Battery? (The closest equivalents)](https://nularo.com/guides/apple-watch-body-battery/): No. Body Battery is Garmin's. Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 get a 0-10 Readiness score, and apps like Bevel and Athlytic add a battery-style gauge.
- [Does Apple Watch track sleep debt? (And how to see yours)](https://nularo.com/guides/apple-watch-sleep-debt/): No. Apple Health has no sleep debt number. Here is how to work yours out from the Sleep chart in two minutes, and which apps calculate it for you.
- [Biological age apps for Apple Watch: what they measure](https://nularo.com/guides/biological-age-apps-apple-watch/): Apple's Health Age is announced but not in iOS 27.2. What Whoop Age, Bevel, cardio fitness and other Apple Watch age scores actually measure, and what is free.
- [Finch alternatives for adults (2026)](https://nularo.com/guides/finch-alternatives/): Finch is free, kind and very cute. If the cute or the daily check-ins are the problem, here are 7 alternatives, including apps that read Apple Health.
- [How to track sleep with a partner or friends on iPhone](https://nularo.com/guides/sleep-tracking-with-a-partner-or-friends/): Health Sharing in the iPhone Health app can share sleep with up to five people. Fitness sharing covers rings, not sleep. Here are the apps that fill the gap.
- [Virtual pet apps that use Apple Health (2026)](https://nularo.com/guides/virtual-pet-apps-apple-health/): The virtual pet apps that really read Apple Health in 2026, grouped by what feeds the pet (steps, sleep or full health data) and whether you log by hand.
